title: System
description: Live status of the application, database, Redis, job queues and the realtime service.
loadFailed: The status could not be loaded. Showing the last values.

process.title: Web process load
process.description: In-memory figures of the web process that answered this refresh. With several web processes (TIX_WEB_PROCESSES) each refresh shows the process that happened to answer.
process.poolHint: Requests waiting for a connection: raise WEB_DATABASE_POOL_MAX (mind the connection budget).
process.loopHint: A high event loop lag means this process is CPU bound: add web processes (TIX_WEB_PROCESSES).

seatLocks.title: Seat locks
seatLocks.none: No seats are held in carts right now.

realtime.title: Realtime service
realtime.notReporting: No gateway reports its status. The realtime service is down, or it still runs a version without this feature.

workers.title: Workers
workers.none: No worker is running: jobs, e-mails and seat lock clean-up are on hold.
workers.leaderHint: The leader runs the seat lock sweeper and the waiting room ticker. Which loop last ran is not tracked.
workers.noLeader: No worker holds the leader lease.

metrics.title: Prometheus metrics
metrics.disabled: The metrics endpoint /api/metrics is switched off. Create a token under Settings, Security to enable it.

security.title: Monitoring
security.description: Optional Prometheus endpoint with the numbers of the System page.
security.intro: Scrape /api/metrics with the header Authorization: Bearer <token>. Without a token the endpoint does not exist.
security.removeConfirm: Disable the metrics endpoint? Monitoring tools lose access.
security.tokenHint: Copy it now. It is shown only once and cannot be read again.
security.failed: The token could not be saved.

BACKUP_FAILED.name: Backup failed
BACKUP_FAILED.description: A scheduled or manual backup failed, the upload to the external target failed, or the automatic test restore of the newest backup failed.

BACKUP_OVERDUE.name: Backup overdue
BACKUP_OVERDUE.description: No successful backup within the expected time although scheduled backups are on.

DISK_LOW.name: Storage running low
DISK_LOW.description: Disk space of the worker container or the database + file storage is above the threshold.

JOBS_FAILING.name: Background jobs failing
JOBS_FAILING.description: Many background jobs failed in the last hour, or jobs are waiting for too long.

EMAIL_DELIVERY_FAILING.name: E-mail delivery failing
EMAIL_DELIVERY_FAILING.description: E-mails failed permanently (e.g. SMTP settings wrong).

REVIEW_CASES_OPEN.name: Bank review cases open (daily digest)
REVIEW_CASES_OPEN.description: Bank transactions waiting in the review list (Klärfälle) for several days.

BANK_SYNC_FAILING.name: Bank sync failing
BANK_SYNC_FAILING.description: A bank connection could not be synchronised, or a TAN has been pending, for several hours.

PAYMENT_PROVIDER_ERRORS.name: Payment provider errors
PAYMENT_PROVIDER_ERRORS.description: PayPal rejects the credentials, or automatic refunds failed.

REFUNDS_OPEN.name: Manual refunds open (daily digest)
REFUNDS_OPEN.description: Manual refunds waiting for a transfer for several days.

UPDATE_AVAILABLE.name: Update available
UPDATE_AVAILABLE.description: A newer version is available for your update channel.

account.title: Warning e-mails
account.description: Choose which warnings you receive by e-mail at your account address. Which warnings are offered depends on your role.
account.none: There are no warnings for your role.
account.defaultHint: You have not changed anything yet: the defaults of your role apply.
account.globalOff: Warning e-mails are switched off for the whole installation (Settings → Notifications).

history.title: Warning history
history.description: The last 50 warnings: when a problem was first noticed, when it was last mailed and whether it is resolved.

settings.title: Warning e-mails
settings.description: Admins get an e-mail when something needs attention. Each admin chooses the warnings on the own account page; the texts can be edited under E-mail templates.
settings.enabledHint: Master switch: when off, nothing is checked or mailed.
settings.sendResolved: Send a short note when a warning clears
settings.maxMailsPerHourHint: All recipients together. Held-back warnings are sent later.
settings.digestTimeHint: Shop time zone. Used for open review cases and open manual refunds.
settings.storageCapacityGbHint: 0 = do not check this. The disk of the database server itself is not visible to the worker – enter the space you have reserved.
settings.diskPaths: Directories of the worker container to check
settings.diskPathsHint: Comma separated. Directories that are not mounted are skipped.

loadTest.title: Load test mode
loadTest.description: Time-limited switch for a realistic load test against this server (see docs/LOAD-TEST.md).
loadTest.intro: While active, requests that carry the header X-Tix-Loadtest with the token below skip only the per-IP throughput limits of the shop (seat requests, checkout, shop entry, realtime token). Login, two-factor, scanner, per-session, per-e-mail and per-code limits, seat locking and all order limits stay in force. The mode ends by itself, every step is written to the audit log.
loadTest.durationHint: 5 to 240 minutes. The mode switches off automatically.
loadTest.disableConfirm: Disable the load test mode? A running load generator is limited by the per-IP limits again.
loadTest.tokenHint: Copy it now and pass it to the load generator (--loadtest-token). It is shown only once and cannot be read again.
loadTest.banner: Load test mode is active until {time}. Per-IP limits are skipped for the load generator.

errors.TWO_FACTOR_REQUIRED: Set up an authenticator app or a passkey in your account first.
errors.LOADTEST_ACTIVE: A load test is already active.
errors.RATE_LIMITED: Too many attempts. Please try again later.
errors.TWO_FACTOR_CODE_REQUIRED: Enter the code of your authenticator app (or a recovery code), or confirm with a passkey.
errors.PASSKEY_INVALID: The passkey could not be verified. Please try again.

loadTest.passkeyHint: Instead of a code you can confirm with your passkey.
